What the record says

  • The Raiders' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is road underdog (all time): 155-132-8 against the spread, a 54.0% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is underdog of 0.5 to 3 (since 2002): 29-40-4, 42.0%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is 38 to 41.5 (50-45-2, 52.6% over) and least often at 45 to 47.5 (38-49-3, 43.7%).
  • All time they have covered 47.2% at home and 49.8% on the road, a 2.6 point edge on the road.
